title: FATF Travel Rule Cross-Border Threshold Checker
description: Determine Travel Rule data obligations for cross-border wire or virtual asset transfer by originating/destination jurisdiction. Covers US FinCEN, EU TFR 2023/1113, UK MLR 2017, SG MAS PSN02, AU AUSTRAC, UAE CBUAE, CH FINMA, FATF baseline. Policy Mandate JSON Travel Rule payload stub. Client-side. Zero PII.
